subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept announce:v1 completion delivery turns as delivery-only, tool-free runs that are reconciled to non-running state instead of resumed as human turns after restart?
rationale: The patch is coherent, but this choice defines session recovery semantics and a security/tool boundary that green CI cannot authorize for maintainers.

options.title: Accept announce delivery semantics
options.body: Approve the PR's model that completion announce handoffs are delivery-only, tool-free turns whose interrupted state is reconciled without human restart recovery.

options.title: Adjust lifecycle status before merge
options.body: Ask for a narrower terminal-state or marker policy if status "killed" is not the desired persisted state for interrupted announce delivery.

options.title: Pause for alternate design
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want announce recovery handled through a broader run-state model rather than an announce-specific persisted marker.

recommendation.title: Accept announce delivery semantics
recommendation.body: Approve the PR's model that completion announce handoffs are delivery-only, tool-free turns whose interrupted state is reconciled without human restart recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on restart lifecycle, gateway lifecycle state, and Codex tool-surface paths where this history is the strongest available routing signal.
